why: The tree scan is the widest-reaching gate this repository has, and the only evidence it is working is that it fails when it should. Each edit below is a way it could stop scanning without anything going red.

mutations.name: every file is skipped
mutations.breaks: The skip rule swallows the tree. Every file reads clean because none is read.
mutations.find: return p.suffix.lower() in SKIP_SUFFIX or bool(SKIP_DIRS & set(parts))

mutations.name: the skip rule reads the absolute path again
mutations.breaks: A checkout under a directory named .claude, bin or .git skips its own entire tree — the bug this checker shipped with for one commit.

mutations.name: an empty shape list is accepted
mutations.breaks: The shared list can be emptied and the scan still reports every file clean — the checker disabled by deleting its input.
mutations.find:
if not shapes:
        sys.exit(f"check-secret-shapes: {path} declares no shapes — refusing to report a clean tree.")
mutations.replace:
if False:
        sys.exit(f"check-secret-shapes: {path} declares no shapes — refusing to report a clean tree.")

mutations.name: an unreadable file is skipped in silence
mutations.breaks: A permissions problem shrinks the scanned set without saying so, and the report still reads clean.
mutations.find: findings.append((p, 0, None, f"could not be read (not scanned): {e}"))

mutations.name: a shape's pattern stops matching
mutations.breaks: The quiet failure every scanner has: a regex that no longer fires on the thing it names, with no symptom at all.

mutations.name: findings are counted and then reported as clean
mutations.breaks: The scan is correct and its verdict is thrown away. This is why the self-test goes through main() and not only through the matching function.
mutations.find:
print("A fixture that needs a credential-shaped value assembles it at run time.")
        return 1
mutations.replace:
print("A fixture that needs a credential-shaped value assembles it at run time.")
        return 0

mutations.name: a scan that read nothing reports clean
mutations.breaks: Enumerated is not examined: every file can be enumerated and then skipped, and the result is a clean report over nothing.

mutations.name: the script's entry point is neutered
mutations.breaks: The verdict never reaches an exit code. A self-test that imports the module and calls check() directly stays green while the script itself always passes.
